affordances.name: Cut
affordances.description: Can sever, slice, or shape suitable materials.

affordances.name: Thrust
affordances.description: Can pierce or stab into resistant materials.

affordances.name: Parry
affordances.description: Can deflect incoming melee attacks if wielded skillfully.

affordances.name: Illuminate
affordances.description: Can provide useful light in dark environments.

affordances.name: Ignite
affordances.description: Can set flammable materials on fire.

affordances.name: Signal
affordances.description: Can be used to communicate at distance through visibility or sound.

affordances.name: Improvised Weapon
affordances.description: Can be wielded as a weapon at reduced effectiveness.

affordances.name: Bash
affordances.description: Can deliver crushing impact.

affordances.name: Shoot
affordances.description: Can launch projectiles to attack at range.

affordances.name: Throw
affordances.description: Can be thrown for ranged effect.

affordances.name: Carry
affordances.description: Distributes load for transport.

affordances.name: Store
affordances.description: Holds other items in defined capacity.

affordances.name: Climb Aid
affordances.description: Assists climbing or rappelling.

affordances.name: Pry
affordances.description: Can lever or force open resistant fixtures.

affordances.name: Probe
affordances.description: Allows safe inspection at a distance.

affordances.name: Mark
affordances.description: Leaves visible marks for navigation or messaging.

affordances.name: Sharpen
affordances.description: Restores or maintains a cutting edge.

affordances.name: Mend
affordances.description: Repairs simple damage to fabric or leather.

affordances.name: Rest
affordances.description: Permits recovery sleep in adverse conditions.

affordances.name: Warm
affordances.description: Provides insulation against cold.

affordances.name: Contain Fluid
affordances.description: Holds liquid for transport or use.

affordances.name: Portable Food
affordances.description: Caloric sustenance shelf-stable for travel.

affordances.name: Bind
affordances.description: Restrains a target.

affordances.name: Treat Injury
affordances.description: Stabilizes wounds or treats illness.

affordances.name: Pick Lock
affordances.description: Defeats mundane mechanical locks.

affordances.name: Reflect
affordances.description: Reflects line of sight around obstructions.
